nodes.label: Eurogroove
nodes.rationale: ESC-related tracks; avoids grand final mega-hits to maintain fresh sounds.

nodes.label: Joker Rule
nodes.rationale: Replaces the most overused direction every 8 charts to balance overall frequency.

nodes.label: Time Zebra (Retro/Modern)
nodes.rationale: Maintains balance between nostalgic retro releases and fresh modern tracks.

nodes.label: Energy Arc Balance
nodes.rationale: Ensures playlist flows naturally from Low to Mid to High and back to Mid.

nodes.label: Hit-Maker Scoring System
nodes.rationale: Uses a progressive scale (15, 12, 10...) instead of linear to reward tracks that evoke strong emotions and prevent bland average tracks from winning.

nodes.label: Reach Threshold
nodes.rationale: Requires at least 25% of voters to rate a track; prevents outlier wins driven by a single extremely high score.
